scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared apps/server ops scripts deploy && npm -w @hf/web run typecheck --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: tsc -b packages/shared && npm -w @hf/web run build && playwright test -c apps/web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run licences && npm test
scripts.images: docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile -t highland/app:$npm_package_version --build-arg APP_VERSION=$npm_package_version --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) . && docker build -f deploy/ops.Dockerfile -t highland/ops:$npm_package_version .
